أتسبسب (form IIq)
# أَتَسَبْسَبُ (ʔatasabsabu) /ʔa.ta.sab.sa.bu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of تَسَبْسَبَ (tasabsaba)
# أَتَسَبْسَبَ (ʔatasabsaba) /ʔa.ta.sab.sa.ba/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of تَسَبْسَبَ (tasabsaba)
# أَتَسَبْسَبْ (ʔatasabsab) /ʔa.ta.sab.sab/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of تَسَبْسَبَ (tasabsaba)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
